title: HexStrike connects AI agents to more than 150 security-testing tools
friendlyTitle: HexStrike lets approved AI agents use many security-testing tools
summary: HexStrike is an MIT-licensed MCP framework that exposes more than 150 penetration-testing and security-research tools to AI agents, with packaged agents for vulnerability analysis and related workflows. The roughly 11,700-star project ranked third in the day’s collected AI-related GitHub trend momentum.
friendlySummary: The project connects agents to more than 150 tools used for finding and studying security weaknesses. It can organize testing, but it also gives the agent powerful capabilities.
whyItMatters: Authorized security teams can use it to orchestrate repeatable lab tests and bring tool output into an agent workflow. Because it grants agents powerful offensive capabilities, run it only against systems you own or are explicitly permitted to test, inside an isolated environment with narrow network access and human approval for consequential actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it only on systems you own or have clear permission to test. Keep it isolated, limit network access and require a person to approve risky actions.
